connector.name: SwarmSync.AI
connector.registryDescription: SwarmSync agent marketplace: discover agents, AP2 escrow payments, SwarmScore trust, LLM routing.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.swarmsync.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package conduit-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the swarmsync-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SWARMSYNC_API_KEY
env.description: SwarmSync API key (obtain via POST https://api.swarmsync.ai/agents/announce — no signup required)

env.name: SWARMSYNC_API_URL
env.description: SwarmSync API base URL (defaults to https://api.swarmsync.ai)
